name: Medusa.js Admin API
tagline: Headless commerce Admin API for products, orders, and store operations
description: Medusa is an open-source headless commerce engine. Its Admin API is a REST interface for managing products, orders, customers, inventory, and store configuration on self-hosted or Medusa Cloud deployments. Auth and base URL depend on your Medusa backend instance.

auth.details: Session/JWT or API key depending on Medusa version and setup; verify against current docs

pricing.free_tier_limits: Open-source self-hosted free; Cloud plans vary — verify on pricing page

use_cases: list products in a Medusa store
create or update product catalog entries
